notes.title: Trail of Angels VR — Major Visual Update Now Live!
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513771/320213c8c9ba0714b6025f8fe97844a8ced2d8a3.png"]

Step deeper into the mysterious afterlife…

We’ve just released a powerful new update for Trail of Angels VR, bringing you an even more immersive and breathtaking experience:

* Sharper Resolution – See the spirit realm like never before, with enhanced visual clarity that brings every ethereal detail to life.

* Vibrant Color Enhancements – The palette of the afterlife has been reborn. Richer tones and deeper contrasts breathe new life into every scene.

* Improved Object Dynamics – Some of the otherworldly elements now move and react with greater realism, pulling you further into the dreamlike journey.



Whether you're returning or visiting for the first time…

Don't be afraid to wander.

The afterlife has secrets waiting to be uncovered.



Update your experience now on Steam and step beyond the veil.
